{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
At some point between the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a '''communications complex''' was manned by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] on [[Galvoni III]] of the [[Galvoni system/Legends|Galvoni system]].<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> It was overseen by the [[Imperial Records Office/Legends|Imperial Records Office]], the complex contained an immense collection of data relating to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], including an early [[Imperial Schematic Design System]] data of the battlestation that featured its [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser]] directly on the station's equatorial trench, holocam transmissions of then non-Rebel Alliance-affiliated individuals Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] orchestrating a rescue of Rebel Alliance leader Princess Leia Organa from [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]], footages of fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disabling [[Tractor Beam 12/Legends|Tractor Beam 12]]; Imperial Enforcer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] overseeing the interrogation of Organa via an IT-O interrogator droid; droids inside the Maintenance Section 19-52 that were later identified by Rebel agents as being droids that had been stolen from the Jawas on Tatooine; Organa, Solo, Chewbacca, and Skywalker escaping via compactor 3263827; Organa and Skywalker's crossing of the central core shaft; Solo and Chewbacca narrowly escaping through a closing blast door; a briefing in the Death Star's conference room shortly after Vader had captured Organa in the Tatooine system; the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} capture by the Death Star's tractor beams; and Death Star gunners within one of the Death Star's tributary beam shafts. In the aftermath of the Death Star's destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] infiltrated this base, and managed to steal a large amount of data transmitted from the Death Star up to its final moments.<ref name="GG1-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>
